items.title: Starry Night Motion Blur Portrait
items.prompt: Preserve the face from the source photo: features, proportions, natural asymmetry, hair colour, skin tone. Face is softened by strong motion blur and out-of-focus blur at the same time, but the silhouette and features match the source. Ignore everything else from the source photo: background, clothing, pose, angle, lighting, composition. Night in a remote location far from city lights. The sky fills most of the frame — a dense scatter of stars, the glowing band of the Milky Way clearly visible running diagonally across the sky, a faint haze of nebulae. A dark horizon below, distant hill silhouettes barely visible. She stands facing the camera. The moment: a sudden gust of wind hits her — her body sways slightly, her head turns, the motion not yet settled. Her face is blurry for two combined reasons: the camera missed focus on her (out-of-focus blur) AND she moved during the shot (motion blur from the sudden gust). Both effects stack together — her face is soft, unfocused, and streaked in the direction of the movement. Facial contours double, features softened and generalized, no single point sharp. Still, the head silhouette and overall expression are guessable, the face stays recognizable by general shape, the features remain correct and attractive. Hair flew apart into long powerful blurred trails from the wind. Her face is lit by a soft warm light from below and in front — like a flashlight or small ground-level source — this light picks her out of the darkness, while the sky behind her stays completely dark and starry, not overexposed. Expression: a warm live smile, lips parted, corners raised — readable through the blur. Not a serious face. Clothing: {argument name="outfit" default="a long flowing slip dress in deep emerald silk"}, thin straps, the hem catching the wind and blurred by the motion, the dark fabric dissolving into the night. Hair: braided into a loose low braid over one shoulder, loose strands flying from the wind. Skin: the warm underlight creates soft upward shadows, detailed texture where untouched by the blur. Colour grading: {argument name="color aesthetic" default="Fujifilm Pacific Blues"} aesthetic — deep saturated blue tones in the sky and Milky Way, a warm contrasting accent from the underlight. Long-exposure astrophotography: stars sharp and detailed, light grain, cinematic quality, vertical composition. --ar 4:5 --raw
